mapper.sql: select a.assignment_id, a.dept_id, a.subject_id, a.assign_date, a.knowledge_id, a.book_name, a.page_from, a.page_to, a.question_text, a.complete_definition, a.due_count_week, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, d.dept_name, sub.subject_name, k.knowledge_name from spas_practice_assignment a left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.dept_id left join spas_subject sub on sub.subject_id = a.subject_id left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = a.knowledge_id
mapper.select: where a.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
where a.dept_id = #{deptId} and a.subject_id = #{subjectId} and a.assign_date = #{assignDate} and coalesce(a.status,'0') = '0'
where a.dept_id = #{deptId} and a.subject_id = #{subjectId} and a.assign_date < #{beforeDate} and coalesce(a.status,'0') = '0' order by a.assign_date desc limit 1
mapper.sql: select c.checkout_id, c.assignment_id, c.group_id, c.practice_date, c.leader_student_id, c.checker_student_id, c.submit_time, c.device_code, c.status, g.group_name, ls.student_name as leader_student_name, cs.student_name as checker_student_name from spas_practice_checkout c left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_student ls on ls.student_id = c.leader_student_id left join spas_student cs on cs.student_id = c.checker_student_id
mapper.select: where c.checkout_id = #{checkoutId}
where c.group_id = #{groupId} and c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and c.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into spas_practice_checkout( assignment_id, group_id, practice_date, leader_student_id, checker_student_id, submit_time, device_code, status, create_time ) values ( #{assignmentId}, #{groupId}, #{practiceDate}, #{leaderStudentId}, #{checkerStudentId}, now(), #{deviceCode}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), now() )
mapper.update: update spas_practice_checkout set checker_student_id = #{checkerStudentId}, device_code = #{deviceCode}, submit_time = now(), update_time = now() where checkout_id = #{checkoutId}
update spas_practice_checkout_item set follow_status = #{followStatus} where item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.checkout_id, i.student_id, i.finish_status, i.difficulty_note, i.member_ack, i.ack_time, i.voided, i.follow_status, i.spot_result, s.student_no, s.student_name, c.group_id, g.group_name from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}

select i.item_id, i.checkout_id, i.student_id, i.finish_status, i.difficulty_note, i.member_ack, i.ack_time, i.voided, i.follow_status, i.spot_result, s.student_no, s.student_name, c.group_id, g.group_name from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id where i.checkout_id = #{checkoutId} order by s.student_no

select i.item_id, i.checkout_id, i.student_id, i.finish_status, i.difficulty_note, i.member_ack, i.ack_time, i.voided, i.follow_status, i.spot_result, s.student_no, s.student_name, c.group_id, g.group_name from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id where i.student_id = #{studentId} and c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.member_ack,'0') = '0'
mapper.sql:
and g.dept_id = #{deptId}
and (g.subject_id = #{subjectId} or g.subject_id is null)
mapper.select:
select i.item_id as "itemId", i.student_id as "studentId", i.finish_status as "finishStatus", i.difficulty_note as "difficultyNote", i.member_ack as "memberAck", i.spot_result as "spotResult", i.voided as "voided", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", c.group_id as "groupId", g.group_name as "groupName", c.checker_student_id as "checkerStudentId", a.book_name as "bookName", a.page_from as "pageFrom", a.page_to as "pageTo", a.question_text as "questionText", a.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", k.knowledge_name as "knowledgeName", a.complete_definition as "completeDefinition", (select count(1) from spas_practice_spot sp where sp.student_id = i.student_id) as "spotHistCount" from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_practice_assignment a on a.assignment_id = c.assignment_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = a.knowledge_id where c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.spot_result,'') = ''
order by i.item_id

select g.group_id as "groupId", g.group_name as "groupName", g.leader_student_id as "leaderStudentId", ls.student_name as "leaderStudentName", (select count(1) from spas_study_group_member m where m.group_id = g.group_id and m.leave_time is null) as "memberCount" from spas_study_group g left join spas_student ls on ls.student_id = g.leader_student_id where coalesce(g.status,'0') = '0'
and not exists ( select 1 from spas_practice_checkout c inner join spas_practice_assignment a on a.assignment_id = c.assignment_id where c.group_id = g.group_id and c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and a.dept_id = #{deptId} and a.subject_id = #{subjectId} ) order by g.sort_order, g.group_id

select i.item_id as "itemId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", g.group_name as "groupName", i.finish_status as "finishStatus" from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id where c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.member_ack,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0'

select i.item_id as "itemId", i.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", g.group_name as "groupName", i.finish_status as "finishStatus" from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id where c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and coalesce(i.member_ack,'0') = '2'

select coalesce(k.knowledge_name, '未标主题') as "knowledgeName", a.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", count(1) as "studentCount" from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_practice_assignment a on a.assignment_id = c.assignment_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = a.knowledge_id where c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and i.finish_status = '3' and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0'
group by a.knowledge_id, k.knowledge_name order by count(1) desc

select i.item_id as "itemId", i.student_id as "studentId", s.student_name as "studentName", s.student_no as "studentNo", i.difficulty_note as "difficultyNote", g.group_name as "groupName", i.follow_status as "followStatus", a.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId" from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_practice_assignment a on a.assignment_id = c.assignment_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id left join spas_student s on s.student_id = i.student_id where c.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and i.finish_status = '3' and coalesce(c.status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0'
order by i.follow_status, i.item_id

select count(1) from spas_practice_spot sp inner join spas_practice_checkout_item i on i.item_id = sp.item_id inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id where c.group_id = #{groupId} and sp.spot_result = '2' and c.practice_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate}

select count(1) from spas_practice_checkout_item i inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id where c.group_id = #{groupId} and i.finish_status = '3' and coalesce(i.follow_status,'0') = '0' and coalesce(i.voided,'0') = '0' and c.practice_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate}

select count(1) from spas_practice_spot sp inner join spas_practice_checkout_item i on i.item_id = sp.item_id inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id where g.dept_id = #{deptId} and (g.subject_id = #{subjectId} or g.subject_id is null) and c.practice_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate}

select g.group_id as "groupId", g.group_name as "groupName" from spas_study_group g where coalesce(g.status,'0') = '0'
order by g.sort_order, g.group_id

select distinct c.checker_student_id from spas_practice_spot sp inner join spas_practice_checkout_item i on i.item_id = sp.item_id inner join spas_practice_checkout c on c.checkout_id = i.checkout_id inner join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = c.group_id where sp.spot_result = '2' and g.dept_id = #{deptId} and c.practice_date >= #{beginDate}
